what: While the screen-height photo collection (32-cell grid, 20px gaps and 20px corners) is pinned to the screen, one center photo grows to full screen with no curve, from 33% of the section length (center anchored) to 55% (top anchored). Its corners go to 0 and it settles 60px lower (scrub 1 — follows the scroll with a 1s lag). When 75% of the section reaches the top of the screen, the whole collection fades out and moves on to the next section

options.length: Length of the attached section (screen heights), default 3
options.from · to: Start and end share of the growth (0~1), default .33 · .55
options.[data-fx-part=stage]: Panel that sticks at screen height (photo set)
options.[data-fx-part=grow]: Growing photo (panel inside the center cell)
options.min: Not applied below this width (px), default 0 — original 1025 (on phones, the using side’s css frees the panel height)

from.where: index.html .ma-photo (eleven-photo collection below the Hero — middle column 13/21 by screen size, data-sticky-trigger 01)
from.options: length: 3; from: 0.33; to: 0.55; fade: 0.75; drop: 60; scrub: 1; min: 1025
